name: ComfyUI-TurntableGSViewer
description: Provides a viewer node for visualizing Gaussian splats in ComfyUI with camera controls.

name: ComfyUI-MultiModel3D
description: Provides tools for merging multiple GLB files and interactive visualization of sub-models within a single GLB workflow.

name: ComfyUI-BodyRatioMapper
description: A tool for pose alignment and human body proportion mapping based on SDPose, supporting multi-person scenarios with keypoint transformation.
nodes_list: BodyRatioMapperProportionTransfer, SDPose Bone Scale, SDPose Translate

name: ComfyUI-Pixal3D
description: ComfyUI wrapper for Tencent's Pixal3D, a SIGGRAPH 2026 single-image to PBR-textured-3D pipeline.

name: ComfyUI-WepeNerd
description: This package provides tools for loading and interactively placing 3D OBJ models in ComfyUI, including clay preview rendering and compositing with background images.

name: ComfyUI-DukeStereo
description: This package converts video frames to side-by-side stereo format for VR viewing, utilizing depth maps for 3D effect creation.

name: Slimy_HMR2_VNCCS
description: Converts HMR2 3D human pose keypoints into VNCCS PoseStudio-compatible JSON for 3D avatar posing, including SMPL coordinate conversions and bone rotations.

name: ComfyUI_KleinAngleSelector
description: Provides interactive 3D camera angle selection for generating multi-view prompts used in 3D reconstruction workflows.

name: ComfyUI-MultiAngle-Camera
description: This package provides a 3D camera controller for generating multi-angle views of scenes, useful for 3D reconstruction and cinematic workflows.
nodes_list: Multi-Angle Camera, 3D球体交互控制器, 预设角度快速切换, 智能提示词生成, 数值参数输出

name: ComfyUI RGB-X
description: This package provides nodes for decomposing RGB images into material channels (albedo, normal, roughness, metallic, irradiance) and generating realistic photos from these intrinsic channels, which is useful for 3D texturing workflows.
nodes_list: RGB -> X, X -> RGB, X -> RGB Inpainting

name: ComfyUI-CXN
description: Provides nodes for loading FBX 3D models and rendering them with camera controls, including texture application and canonical orientation adjustments.

name: ComfyTimeline
description: Provides a global timeline and curve editor for animating properties in ComfyUI, enabling frame-accurate animation workflows.

name: ComfyUI-Recgen
description: Turns RGB images with depth maps and object masks into 3D meshes and optional Gaussian splats using RecGen's 2D to 3D reconstruction.
nodes_list: RecGen 2D to 3D, RecGen Load Example Inputs

name: ComfyUI_GaussianSplatToMesh
description: Converts Gaussian Splat point cloud data (PLY_DATA) into 3D meshes (TRIMESH) using multiple reconstruction methods for export in GLB/OBJ/PLY/STL formats.

name: ComfyUI-GaussianPack
description: Provides a WebGL preview node for Gaussian Splatting data with camera-intrinsics controls.

name: MoGe-2
description: Provides ComfyUI nodes for MoGe-2, a monocular metric geometry estimation model that generates depth maps, point clouds, normals, and camera intrinsics from single images.

name: ComfyUI-SkinTokens
description: A ComfyUI plugin for automated 3D character rigging and skinning, featuring a headless Blender server and interactive FBX preview.

name: Pixal3D-env
description: ComfyUI nodes for Pixal3D, enabling pixel-aligned image-to-3D generation with single image input and textured GLB output.

name: UniDepth
description: Provides ComfyUI nodes for UniDepthV2, a universal monocular metric depth estimation model that predicts depth, camera intrinsics, and per-pixel 3D point maps from a single RGB image.

name: Dustin ComfyUI Nodes
description: Generates 3D worlds using the Marble API from World Labs, supporting text-to-3D, image-to-3D, video-to-3D, and multi-image reconstruction modes.

name: ComfyUI_RH_Pixal3D
description: Custom nodes for TencentARC Pixal3D, enabling 3D asset generation from single images with GLB format export and camera metadata for downstream preview.

name: ComfyUI Image Hang Gallery
description: A 3D gallery extension for ComfyUI that visualizes generated images in a customizable walkable 3D space.

name: HYWM2
description: ComfyUI wrapper for HY-World 2.0 / WorldMirror 2.0 that performs 3D reconstruction from multi-view images, generating depth, normals, point clouds, and 3D Gaussian Splatting.

name: LiTo Image-to-3D
description: Generates 3D Gaussian Splats from single images, capturing geometry and view-dependent appearances, with export to PLY format.
nodes_list: LiTo Load Model, LiTo Preprocess Image, LiTo Image to 3D, LiTo Export PLY, LiTo Preview Point Cloud

name: Pixal3D
description: Provides ComfyUI nodes for TencentARC Pixal3D, enabling image-to-3D generation with textured GLB export and camera control.
